what: On hover the background swaps through five colors (blue, pink, lime, purple, orange, values rotated from the skin’s accent color) in hard steps every .4s with no in-between values, one full cycle every 2s. Each hover shifts the starting color by one, so the same button starts from a different color every time. The ”ink” type cycles the text color instead of the background

options.dur: Length of one revolution (seconds), default 2 — five slots, so one color is dur/5
options.look: “ink” makes the text color cycle instead of the background (back-to-top button)
options.--fx-c0~4: Five colors — by default five turned in oklch from --kf-accent (the original blue #5684fe, pink, lime, purple and orange are values derived from the pink accent)

use: View details · Text color: data-fx-color-step-hover="look: ink"

from.where: shared.css .c-mo-colorful (header category pills · left menu · schedule bar · campaign button · map link — original hover-colorful-animation 2s steps(1), data-hover-colorful-start advanced one step on each mouseenter) · .p-footer__pagetop (text color type, hover-pagetop-animation)

note: Not applied on touch devices (you can’t hover). Color goes on a button whose background is filled — a border-only button gets a background
